text:
elaine: Heads-up — planning doc for next-week model roll. Need quick sync on rollout spec: pinning, canary %, rollback triggers, and experiment metrics. TL;DR: Acme beta wants deterministic pinning for 2 weeks.

sam: @elaine can you share the initial acceptance criteria you were thinking?

elaine: Sure — draft: 1) 99th p90 latency < 250ms for seq<=1024, 2) token-cost within 10% of baseline, 3) no safety regression on our testset (zero-false-positive cap = 0.5%), 4) error rate < 0.2%.

rita: For safety regression we should run both the standard eval and the new customer prompt corpus. I can run that overnight and post results.

yusuf: For rollback triggers we should be explicit: immediate rollback on SLO breach > 5m sustained OR spike in downstream errors > 1% for 10m. Also automated fallback to last-stable model variant.

sam: Sounds good. What about pinning semantics? Acme requires "session pinning" so a user remains on a version for 14 days. Do we do tenant-level pin or session cookie?

elaine: We agreed tenant-level pin for enterprise accounts. Need policy for expiration and forced-unpin for safety fixes. Proposal: pin TTL=14d, manual override for security fixes that can unpin and force fallback (with audit log).

rita: Edge cases: long-running sessions (chat threads with >24h gaps). Suggest a soft-refresh: renew pin if last activity <14d, otherwise treat new session as unpinned.

sam: For the A/B experiment matrix: initial canary 5% traffic for 2h, ramp to 20% over 24h if no regression, then 100% over 48h after final checks? Or do we want A/B for quality evaluation with 50/50 for a small cohort?

elaine: Plan: two-phase—(1) safety/ops canary: 5% -> 20% -> 100% (ops checks), (2) controlled A/B for quality: 20% cohort split 50/50 vs baseline for 72h to collect human-rated evals and embeddings drift metrics.

yusuf: Need automated observability hooks: anomaly alert if p95 latency delta > 30ms, cost-per-token > 15% and token error rate > threshold. Also ensure tracing headers pass through so we can do per-tenant debugging.

sam: I'm adding a minimal rollout config snippet to the PRD draft. Please sanity-check:

sam: ```json
{
  "rollout": {
    "canary": {"start": 0.05, "max": 0.2, "ramp_hours": 24},
    "full": {"after_hours": 72},
    "pin_ttl_days": 14,
    "rollback": {"slo_breach_minutes": 5, "error_rate_threshold": 0.01}
  }
}
```

rita: Looks good. Add a separate flag for forced-unpin (boolean) that only admins can trigger.

elaine: Acceptance checklist to include in PRD: deployment runbook, observability dashboards (latency, cost, safety), manual test script for customer prompts, rollback playbook, communication plan to affected customers.

yusuf: I'll stub alerts and dashboards in grafana and share links in the PRD draft by EOD.

deploy-bot: deploy started for canary-ops-config v2 -> prod (triggered by sam)

sam: Thanks — I'll update PRD and push a short RFC for review. Can we do a 15-min sync tomorrow 10:30am to align on rollout window and who owns what?

elaine: Yes booked. Agenda: finalize pin policy wording, confirm metrics/thresholds, assign runbook owners.

rita: I'll attach the safety eval artifacts before the meeting.

yusuf: I'll add the tracing and alert links.

elaine: Great — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
